subject: integration
name: Uniswap
summary: The built-in swap of Ether or a pinned token into a pinned token through Uniswap's open-source Universal Router and QuoterV2 at pinned mainnet addresses, paid exactly to the payee. It prices from a read the Ethereum light client proves (an unproven one is refused), caps the input at the limit the person confirmed, signs only the call it wrote, and ends on the exact Transfer to the payee. No party holds funds. Other reads and the send come through the Ethereum codes from the provider the person chose, judged on its own row. It reaches no server of its own. Judged here by its publisher.
